arguments.description: Replace the hall with one village entrance: two thick sculptural living roots curve upward into an open timber ceremonial gateway, topped by a small layered leaf-shingle cap, carved hanging sign and two restrained golden rope lanterns. The central passage is visibly open, without a door or building behind. Keep refined native pixel clusters, the exact forest-green/brown palette, shallow three-quarter perspective and upper-left lighting. Transparent background, no landscape or ground shadow.
